## New Features
- Count usage from TRAE CLI, Antigravity Insiders and Copilot SDK logs, including VS Code Agent mode. - Recover Codex usage from compressed session archives. A session with both a text copy and a compressed copy is counted once.
## Fixes
- Count distinct Pi requests that share a response ID, and distribute Hermes session totals across days using assistant message times. - Estimate Antigravity’s Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 requests at the model’s API rate across all four effort levels. Previously unpriced requests are filled in when a matching rate is available. - The activity calendar now matches the other Overview cards and outlines the day under the pointer. The usage history chart uses stable, rounded axis labels. - Speed chart outliers line up with their distribution boxes. Key usage figures use Maple Mono, including Chinese units.
